scope: I22 decision-2 part A development pilot: He, Ne and Ar photoionization X -> X+ + e- as real particle events through the normal native cohort owner; supporting evidence only, not formal I22 or ensemble-precision qualification

mechanical_budget.use: the three relative limits apply unchanged to parent, ion and electron; the classical-speed cap is 3.4e6 m/s for I22 (approval "limits")

model: source-effective photon (D04 printed threshold + D04 endpoint mean excess) with the physical ground-ion formation energy; photoelectron isotropic in the parent rest frame, booked to the signed electron bath; ground ion only
admitted_observables: heavy number, charge and mass budgets and event chronology; ion and electron energy observables are not admitted
unpopulated_eligible_states: Ar+ 3s-1 (~13.5 eV above the ground ion)
geometry: actual frozen SPICE 2009-01-24T00:00:00, sphere Moon, LSO start (1e7, 0, 0) m, +1 m/s along x, point Sun, Earth occultation off
reference_problem: compiled normal zero-acceleration kernel; Na weight reference, tracked parent and ground ion (compile mappings Na/He/He_PLUS, Na/Ne/Ne_plus, Na/Ar/AR_PLUS)
matrix: both force-cut-surface movers; 8, 16 and 32 common steps; 1 and 8 MPI ranks, OMP 1; seed 731993; mover substep cap tracing_maximum_substep_s equal to the coarsest common step (horizon/8) in every case, so each refinement also refines the photon-history segments (revision b)
cases: approval "cases" (horizons and parent counts chosen so recoiling ions stay inside the domain), with the revision parent counts (He-quiet 8,192 so one mover run fits the one-hour owner limit)
campaign_2_inputs: protocol sha256 fd5dbae127e52e9f8d7d0d1bfab22f59e36f3bf9f2bbd910594a36adfa194e0d with every substep cap at 8192 s; its Ne/Ar refinement FAILs are retained evidence
oracles: Independent D04 endpoint rate and inverse-square checks
statistics: the 2% ensemble rate gate is reported, not scored, at these cohort sizes
